pageDescription: Complete your intake before your appointment. Talk or type with Ace, our AI assistant.
startSubheading: Tell Ace what's going on so your provider has everything they need. Takes just a few minutes.
hipaaNote: Private to you and your care team. Not for emergencies — if this is urgent, call 911.
completeSubheading: Your provider will review your responses before your appointment. You can view this intake in your patient portal.
errorLabel: Something went wrong. Please try again.
stepChiefComplaintSubtitle: Select the symptom that best describes your main concern.
stepChiefComplaintDescriptionLabel: Describe your symptoms in your own words
stepChiefComplaintDescriptionPlaceholder: E.g. sharp pain in my left side that started this morning…
stepSeveritySubtitle: Rate the intensity on a scale from 1 to 10.
stepDurationTitle: How long have you had this symptom?
stepAssociatedTitle: Do you have any of these associated symptoms?
stepMedicationsTitle: Are you currently taking any medications?
stepMedicationsSubtitle: Include prescriptions, over-the-counter drugs, and supplements.
stepAllergiesTitle: Do you have any known allergies?
stepAllergiesSubtitle: Include drug, food, and environmental allergies.
stepHistoryTitle: Do you have any of these chronic conditions?
stepNotesTitle: Anything else your provider should know?
stepNotesSubtitle: Optional — add any additional context or concerns.
stepNotesPlaceholder: E.g. recent travel, stress, unusual symptoms…
